commit.message:
Cover remaining Cirq -> Braket conversion paths (#2365) (#3109)

Brings mitiq/interface/mitiq_braket/conversions.py from 97% to 100%,
covering the four paths #2365 lists as untested:

- Measurement gates are dropped, with a warning. Braket measures
  implicitly, so to_braket removes cirq measurement gates -- a silent
  change to the circuit, which is why it warns. The test pins both
  halves of that contract and that neighbouring gates survive.
- cirq.I maps to Braket I rather than being dropped or decomposed.
- SWAP and ISWAP map to their direct Braket equivalents. Both paths are
  guarded on exponent 1, so the test also asserts a half-swap does NOT
  take them, which is what makes the guard tested rather than assumed.
- A bare matrix carries no qubit, so `target` is required.

Each test was checked to fail when the line it covers is broken.

Change-Id: I7dc262d05b1cf82c81f574cfbcd3a7fbc0279f1d
Assisted-by: Claude (Anthropic)
